target.title: The WebMCP Challenge: 10 days for exploring what’s possible with WebMCP - Devpost
target.symptom: The challenge page should remain usable while an agent captures bounded operational evidence.

evidence.summary: Chrome rendered the public WebMCP Challenge page with its overview, schedule, rules, resources, and submission controls visible.

operatorHandoff: Keep the captured page evidence read-only and do not claim an automated target-site action.
Use the site-owned interface for any change, then capture fresh evidence to verify the result.
